chunk_a.text_snippet:
Title: Canadian mother and daughter ‘traumatized’ by ICE detainment, husband says
Date: 2026-03-20

Content: But since the move to Dilley, Warner and Ayla now at least have mattresses to sleep on, whereas at Rio Grande they were sleeping on the floor, said Edward Warner. Global Affairs Canada, the federal ministry that handles consular services and diplomatic relations, said on Thursday it was “aware of multiple cases of Canadians currently or previously in immigration-related detention in the US”. “Consular officials advocate for Canadian citizens abroad and raise concerns about justified and serious complaints of ill-treatment or discrimination with the local authorities but cannot exempt Canadians from local legal processes,” a spokesperson said. “Due to privacy considerations, no further information can be disclosed.” When asked why Warner and Ayla had been detained, an ICE spokesperson requested more information about the pair “in order to accurately locate” them. The Guardian provided that information, but at the time of publication ICE had not responded.

chunk_b.text_snippet:
Title: Canadian mother held by ICE with daughter, 7, speaks out on families ‘suffering greatly’ in detention
Date: 2026-04-10

Content: The Guardian provided that information, but close to three weeks later, ICE has not replied, despite follow-ups. When asked about Warner and Ayla’s case immediately after their detention, Global Affairs Canada, the federal ministry that handles consular services and diplomatic relations, said it was “aware of multiple cases of Canadians currently or previously in immigration-related detention in the US”. “Consular officials advocate for Canadian citizens abroad and raise concerns about justified and serious complaints of ill-treatment or discrimination with the local authorities but cannot exempt Canadians from local legal processes,” a spokesperson said. “Due to privacy considerations, no further information can be disclosed.” When asked for comment regarding their release, Global Affairs said it did not have anything further to add.

initial_question.rag_input: How did the conditions described by Edward Warner in March 2026 relate to the lack of response from ICE regarding his family's case by April 2026?
initial_question.question: How did the conditions described by Edward Warner in March 2026 relate to the lack of response from ICE regarding his family's case by April 2026?
initial_question.answer: In March 2026, Edward Warner reported that his wife and daughter had moved to Dilley where they finally had mattresses, contrasting with the floor sleeping conditions they endured at the Rio Grande facility. By April 2026, despite the Guardian providing ICE with the information required to locate the family following the initial detention, ICE had still not replied to inquiries regarding their case, even after three weeks of follow-ups.
